issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Adomate
products.tagline: Turn data into winning ads. At scale.
products.summaryZh: 将数据转化为制胜广告。规模化运作。
products.descriptionZh: 使用Adomate，你可以基于数据大规模创建广告。从Meta广告账户、广告库以及Trustpilot和Amazon的评论中获取数据。构建创意研究工作流，按你的方式生成品牌广告概念。所有内容均可追溯至原始数据触发源，无黑箱操作。
products.description: With Adomate you create ads from data, at scale. Take data from your Meta ad account, the ad library and reviews from Trustpilot and Amazon. Build creative research workflows that create branded ad concepts, the way you want. Fully traceable to their original data trigger, no blackbox.

products.name: Artifacts by Databox
products.tagline: Ask your AI Analyst and get back a ready-to-share report
products.summaryZh: 向你的AI分析师提问，即可获得一份可直接分享的报告。
products.descriptionZh: 将您与AI分析师的任何对话转化为基于实时数据生成的精美报告、幻灯片或交互式文档。只需一次提示即可生成，然后通过公开链接分享或下载为PDF。
products.description: Turn any conversation with your AI Analyst into a polished report, slide deck, or interactive document built from your live data. Generate it from a single prompt, then share it via public link or download as a PDF.

products.name: Claude Opus 5
products.tagline: Near-Fable 5 intelligence at half the price
products.summaryZh: 以一半的价格获得接近Fable 5的智能
products.descriptionZh: Opus 5 是 Opus 层级的一次阶跃式改进，为长期运行的智能体提供支持，同时在编程和专业工作方面带来提升。
products.description: Opus 5 is a step change improvement for the Opus tier powering long-running agents while delivering improvements in coding and professional work.

products.name: Webhound
products.tagline: A research engine for your agent
products.summaryZh: 您的智能体研究引擎
products.descriptionZh: 研究没有天然的终点。同一个问题，智能体可以花十分钟或十小时处理，两种答案看起来都像是完成了。Webhound 让你自行决定问题值得投入多少工作量。只需给出一个问题和一个预算金额，它便会追踪线索、核查薄弱主张，直至预算耗尽，然后返回一份附有引用的报告或带来源的数据集，并附带原始来源和工作文档。你可以亲自运行 Webhound，或通过 MCP 或 API 从你的智能体中调用它。
products.description: Research has no natural finish line. An agent can spend ten minutes or ten hours on the same question, and both answers can look finished. Webhound lets you choose how much work the question deserves. Give it a question and a dollar budget. It follows leads and checks weak claims until the budget is consumed, then returns a cited report or sourced dataset with the sources and working documents behind it. Run Webhound yourself or call it from your agent through MCP or the API.

products.name: Robynn AI
products.tagline: Websites that improve and heal with self-learning
products.summaryZh: 通过自我学习来改进和修复的网站
products.descriptionZh: 你的网站在上线当天就开始衰退。失效链接、过时页面、排名下滑、对ChatGPT不可见。Robynn直接连接你的在线网站——无需重建，无需迁移。它会根据你的品牌、ICP和竞争对手，对每个页面进行审计，然后提出有数据支持的修复建议。指向任意元素，用日常英语描述修改内容。代理会暂存修改，你审核通过后，Robynn发布并衡量GA中的变化。有效改进会被强化，倒退则回滚。首次审计免费。
products.description: Your website starts decaying the day it ships. Broken links, stale pages, slipping rankings, invisible to ChatGPT. Robynn connects to your live site — no rebuild, no migration. It audits every page against your brand, ICP, and competitors, then proposes evidence-backed fixes. Point at any element, describe a change in plain English. Agents stage it, you approve, Robynn publishes and measures what moved in GA. Wins get reinforced. Regressions roll back. First audit is free.

products.name: superfile
products.tagline: A modern, visual file manager for the terminal
products.summaryZh: 一款现代化的终端可视化文件管理器
products.descriptionZh: Superfile 是一款现代化的终端文件管理器，拥有精致的多面板界面、强大的预览功能以及深度自定义能力。它让你像使用桌面文件管理器一样浏览、预览和跨面板移动文件，同时完全保持键盘驱动和快速响应。
products.description: Superfile is a modern terminal file manager with a polished multi-panel interface, strong previews, and deep customization. It lets you browse, preview, and move files across panes the way a desktop file manager would, while staying fully keyboard-driven and fast.

products.name: Grok 4.5
products.tagline: SpaceXAI's model for coding, agentic tasks & knowledge work
products.summaryZh: SpaceXAI的编程、智能体任务与知识工作模型
products.descriptionZh: Grok 4.5 在涵盖编程、科学、工程和数学知识的数据集上进行了训练。凭借智能且高效的推理能力，Grok 4.5 在真实工程任务中表现出色，并在此类任务上超越了同类领先模型。
products.description: Grok 4.5 was trained on datasets spanning knowledge in coding, science, engineering, and math. With both intelligent and efficient reasoning, Grok 4.5 excels at real engineering tasks and exceeds comparable leading models at these tasks.

products.name: Rescript
products.tagline: A free, open source, Descript alternative. Runs in-browser.
products.summaryZh: 免费、开源、Descript替代方案。在浏览器中运行。
products.descriptionZh: 🎬 开源、基于转录文本的浏览器视频编辑器。只需编辑转录文本即可剪辑视频。完全在浏览器中运行：本地、免费且支持离线使用！
products.description: 🎬 Open source, transcript-based video editor that lives in the browser. Edit videos by simply editing the transcript text. Runs fully in the browser: Local, free and offline!

products.name: Estera
products.tagline: AI Receptionist that Answers Calls & WhatsApp 24/7
products.summaryZh: 全天候接听电话和WhatsApp的AI前台
products.descriptionZh: 认识Estera，专为房地产、酒店、餐厅等行业打造的AI前台。这款AI前台代理能在5秒内接听每一通电话和WhatsApp消息，自动筛选潜在客户、预约时间并跟进。适用于房地产、酒店、餐厅、牙科诊所等多种场景。3分钟内即可创建专属AI代理助手。
products.description: Meet Estera, the AI receptionist built for real estate, hotels, restaurants, and more. AI agent receptionist that answers every phone call and WhatsApp message in under 5 seconds, qualifies leads, books appointments, and follows up automatically. Built for real estate, hotels, restaurants, dental clinics, and more. Create your own AI agent assistant in under 3 minutes.

products.name: AI YC interview with Gstack agents
products.tagline: AI specialists that join your Google Meet and gives feedback
products.summaryZh: 加入你的Google Meet并提供反馈的AI专家
products.descriptionZh: Garry Tan 开源的 gstack 专家团队——CEO、CSO、QA 负责人、一位 YC 办公时间合伙人及另外 15 位成员——以带有 3D 头像的语音机器人形式加入你的真实 Google Meet 会议。他们以角色身份开场，轮流发言，实时点评你共享的屏幕内容，并在聊天中留下笔记。免费、MIT 许可，其核心是你自己的编程代理会话。基于 AgentCall 构建。
products.description: Garry Tan's open-sourced gstack specialists — CEO, CSO, QA Lead, a YC-office-hours partner and 15 more — join your real Google Meet as voice bots with 3D avatars. They open in-persona, take turns, critique your shared screen out loud, and drop notes in chat. Free, MIT, and the brain is your own coding-agent session. Built on AgentCall.

products.name: localskills.sh
products.tagline: AI Skill & MCP server management for teams & enterprises
products.summaryZh: 面向团队与企业的AI技能与MCP服务器管理
products.descriptionZh: 创建、分享并安装可复用的智能体技能和规则，适用于Cursor、Claude Code、Windsurf等工具。一条安装命令，覆盖所有工具。
products.description: Create, share, and install reusable agent skills and rules for Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, and more. One install command, every tool.

products.name: Comms
products.tagline: Launch iMessage agents in seconds
products.summaryZh: 数秒内启动iMessage智能体
products.descriptionZh: 过去，企业开通iMessage线路意味着要接销售电话、填写运营商表格、等待数周，且每月支付225美元以上才能发出第一条短信。Comms能在约30秒内让真人客服接入真实的iMessage线路。用通俗语言描述，或只需一次API调用即可实现。它能在用户真正阅读的对话线程中处理客服、预约、入职引导和支付。每月免费提供3000条消息，超出后统一收费50美元。
products.description: Getting an iMessage line for your business used to mean sales calls, carrier paperwork, weeks of waiting, and $225+ a month before your first text. Comms puts a live agent on a real iMessage line in about 30 seconds. Describe it in plain English or make one API call. It handles support, bookings, onboarding, and payments inside the thread people actually read. Free to start with 3,000 messages a month, then a flat $50.

products.name: Notate
products.tagline: Annotate anything for humans and their agents
products.summaryZh: 为人类及其代理标注任何内容
products.descriptionZh: Notate适用于任何“指向优于描述”的场景：设计与动效评审、产品演示、代码审查及交接。与截图工具不同，它能在菜单、悬停和聚焦状态消失前将其冻结，或录制操作流程，让你精准标记动画出错的帧。基于手势的标注保持操作流畅；智能裁剪与可重新打开的会话保留图像、评论及上下文，确保反馈在传递给同事或智能体时依然有效。
products.description: Notate is for anything where pointing beats describing: design and motion review, product walkthroughs, code review, and handoffs. Unlike screenshot tools, it freezes open menus, hover and focus states before they disappear, or records a flow so you can pin the exact frame where an animation breaks. Gesture-based annotation keeps the flow fast; smart crop and reopenable sessions preserve the image, comments, and context so feedback stays useful when it reaches a teammate or an agent.

products.name: Rivault
products.tagline: Approve AI agent data access with Face ID
products.summaryZh: 使用Face ID批准AI代理数据访问
products.descriptionZh: Rivault 让您能够安全可靠地为 AI 代理和 CUA 提供任务所需的数据与上下文。将数据和上下文存储在零知识保险库中。当 AI 代理需要数据（如护照号码或信用卡信息）来执行预订航班等任务时，Rivault 会向您发送授权请求，您通过 Face ID 或通行密钥解锁数据，任务完成后数据会被确定性脱敏处理。默认情况下，Rivault 无法访问您的数据。
products.description: Rivault lets you safely and securely provide AI agents and CUA data and context for tasks. Store data and context in a zero-knowledge vault, When an AI agent needs data (Passport No. or Credit Card details) to execute a task like booking a flight, Rivault sends you an auth request, you unlock data with Face ID/ Passkey and data is deterministically redacted after task completes. Rivault never gets access to your data by default.

products.name: FindDiskKiller
products.tagline: See which apps are hammering your Mac's disk
products.summaryZh: 查看哪些应用正在占用你的 Mac 磁盘。
products.descriptionZh: FindDiskKiller 是一款原生 macOS 磁盘活动监控工具，可揭示哪些应用和 AI 编程代理正在驱动读写操作。追踪每个进程的磁盘 I/O、CPU 和网络活动，检查实时文件访问，追踪文件夹，并查看 SMART/NVMe 驱动器健康状态。完全免费且开源。
products.description: FindDiskKiller is a native macOS disk activity monitor that reveals which apps and AI coding agents are driving reads and writes. Track per-process disk I/O, CPU and network activity, inspect live file access, trace folders, and view SMART/NVMe drive health. Completely free and open source.

products.name: Tackly
products.tagline: Map your thoughts in real time with AI.
products.summaryZh: 用AI实时映射你的想法。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数AI笔记工具只会给你一份带摘要的转录文本💅。Tackly能实时将你说的话映射到20个节点中——无论是会议、个人语音笔记还是粘贴的转录文本——让你获得随时可回溯的结构化内容，而非单调的黑白文字。我日常受ADHD困扰，这款工具让我感觉效率提升了很多，再也不会丢失想法。AI笔记工具太无趣了，用Tackly来搞定它们。前往tackly.co免费试用。
products.description: Most AI notetakers hand you a transcript with a summary bolted on 💅 Tackly maps what you say into one of 20 nodes, live and in realtime — from meetings, solo voice notes, or a pasted transcript — so you get structure you can always come back to, not just silly old black and white text. I struggle with ADHD on a day-to-day and this has made me feel a ton more productive, I never lose my thoughts. AI notetakers are boring, tackle them with Tackly. Try it for free at tackly.co

products.name: Cynative Security Research Agent
products.tagline: Ask your cloud anything without breaking prod. Read-only.
products.summaryZh: 向你的云提问一切，无需担心影响生产环境。只读。
products.descriptionZh: 开源AI命令行工具，可解答跨云、代码和运行时的安全问题——支持GitHub、GitLab、AWS、GCP、Azure、K8s。用自然语言提问："哪些本不该公开的内容被暴露了？"或"我的CI能否升级为云管理员？"。设计上为只读：每次调用都会解析为IAM操作，并在凭据附加前通过只读策略授权。即使被要求，也无法修改你的基础设施。与MCP工具不同，它在沙箱化运行时中编写JavaScript——每次交互生成一个脚本，而非单次调用。
products.description: Open-source AI CLI that answers security questions across cloud, code and runtime - GitHub, GitLab, AWS, GCP, Azure, K8s. Ask in plain language: "what's publicly exposed that shouldn't be?" or "can my CI escalate to cloud admin?". Read-only by construction: every call is resolved to its IAM actions and authorized against a read-only policy before credentials attach. It can't modify your infra even if asked. Unlike MCP tools, it writes JS in a sandboxed runtime - a script per turn, not one call.

products.name: Edit Mind × Strava
products.tagline: Every clip matched to the Strava activity it's from
products.summaryZh: 每个片段都与对应的Strava活动匹配
products.descriptionZh: 连接Strava与Edit Mind后，视频中的每个场景都会自动匹配到拍摄时的活动数据：心率、速度、海拔和距离，精确到每一帧。任何相机均可使用，GoPro/运动相机的GPS遥测数据可实现精准匹配。
products.description: Connect Strava and Edit Mind matches every scene in your footage to the activity it was shot on: heart rate, speed, elevation, and distance, aligned to the frame. Any camera works, GoPro/action-cam GPS telemetry makes the match exact.

products.name: iMessage Hermes on a Raspberry Pi
products.tagline: An always-on AI agent that lives in your home
products.summaryZh: 一个常驻家中的全天候AI助手
products.descriptionZh: 一个常驻家中廉价树莓派上的全天候AI代理，配备真实电话号码，可通过iMessage或短信从任何地方发送信息。它运行开源代理Hermes，安装时只需将指南交给通过SSH工作的编码代理即可。最重要的是，它是一个基础平台：在厨房屏幕上搭建家庭日历，在冰箱上设置食谱助手，或实现任何你能想到的功能。我们公开开发——加入Discord看看其他人在做什么。
products.description: An always-on AI agent that lives on a cheap little Raspberry Pi in your home, with a real phone number you text over iMessage or SMS from anywhere. It runs Hermes, an open-source agent, and installs by handing the guide to a coding agent that works over SSH. Best of all, it's a foundation: build a family calendar on a kitchen screen, a recipe helper on the fridge, whatever you dream up. We build in public — join the Discord to see what others are making.

products.name: Repaint Socials
products.tagline: Build a website from Google Business, Instagram, or Facebook
products.summaryZh: 从Google商家、Instagram或Facebook构建网站
products.descriptionZh: 连接你的Google商家资料、Instagram或Facebook页面，Repaint即可通过AI将其转化为精美的网站。它会利用你的真实内容来构建结构、内容和设计，让你在几分钟内就能完善并发布一个完整的网站。
products.description: Connect your Google Business Profile, Instagram, or Facebook page and Repaint turns it into a polished website with AI. It uses your real content to create the structure, content, and design, giving you a complete site you can refine and publish in minutes.
